library_summary_es: La evidencia clínica es variable y suele ser específica de indicación; un mecanismo biológico no demuestra por sí solo un beneficio clínico.
review_requirements: Verify indication-specific evidence and effect size
Verify formulation, dose, duration and population
Review adverse effects, contraindications, medication/supplement interactions
Assess total intake, special populations and safety questions
Document source quality and clinical sign-off
